+---
+module: mount_facts
+short_description: Gather facts about filesystem mounts
+version_added: "2.18"
+author:
+  - Ansible Core Team
+description:
+  - Gather mount information from POSIX mount tables, filesystem configuration files, or the C(mount) command.
+  - The first entry for each mount point is kept in RV(ansible_facts.mount_points).
+extends_documentation_fragment:
+  - action_common_attributes
+  - action_common_attributes.facts
+attributes:
+  check_mode:

+  diff_mode:
+    support: none
+  facts:
+    support: full
+  platform:
+    platforms: posix
+options:
+  sources:
+    description:
+      - Sources to read, in order. A null value is equivalent to V([all]).
+      - V(dynamic) expands to C(/etc/mtab), C(/proc/mounts), and C(/etc/mnttab).
+      - V(static) expands to C(/etc/fstab), C(/etc/vfstab), and C(/etc/filesystems).
+      - V(all) reads the V(dynamic) sources followed by the V(static) sources.
+      - Use an explicit file path to read that file, or V(mount) to run O(mount_binary) after all file sources.
+    type: list
+    elements: str
+  mount_binary:
+    description:
+      - Command to use when V(mount) is requested or none of the requested dynamic files yields an entry.
+      - Set to null to disable the automatic fallback. An explicit V(mount) source still uses the default command.
+    type: raw
+    default: mount
+  devices:
+    description:
+      - Keep mounts whose device matches at least one of these shell-style glob patterns.
+      - A null value does not filter by device.
+    type: list
+    elements: str
+  fstypes:
+    description:
+      - Keep mounts whose filesystem type matches at least one of these shell-style glob patterns.
+      - A null value does not filter by filesystem type.
+    type: list
+    elements: str
+  timeout:
+    description:
+      - Maximum time in seconds to wait for each mount information operation.
+      - Must be greater than zero, or null to wait without a time limit.
+    type: float
+  on_timeout:
+    description:
+      - Fail the module, warn and omit the timed-out operation's result, or omit it silently.
+    type: str
+    choices: [error, warn, ignore]
+    default: error
+  include_aggregate_mounts:
+    description:

+      - If null, omit the entries and warn when a source reports the same mount point more than once.
+    type: bool
+'''
+
+EXAMPLES = r'''
+- name: Gather all mount facts
+  ansible.builtin.mount_facts:
+
+- name: Gather active mounts on selected filesystems
+  ansible.builtin.mount_facts:
+    sources: [dynamic]
+    fstypes: [ext4, xfs]
+    timeout: 5
+    on_timeout: warn
+'''
+
+RETURN = r'''
+ansible_facts:
+  description: Mount information gathered from the requested sources.
+  returned: always
+  type: complex
+  contains:
+    mount_points:
+      description:
+        - The first entry for each mount point, keyed by mount point.
+        - Entries include the parsed mount fields, an C(ansible_context) dictionary with C(source) and C(source_data),
+          a C(uuid) when known (null otherwise), and disk usage statistics when available.
+      returned: always
+      type: dict
+    aggregate_mounts:
+      description: All collected mount entries in source order, or an empty list when O(include_aggregate_mounts) is not enabled.
+      returned: always
+      type: list
+      elements: dict
+'''
+
+import os
+import re
+import subprocess
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from fnmatch import fnmatchcase
+from functools import lru_cache, wraps
+from subprocess import CalledProcessError, TimeoutExpired
+
+from ansible.module_utils.basic import AnsibleModule
+from ansible.module_utils.facts.timeout import TimeoutError, timeout as fact_timeout
+from ansible.module_utils.facts.utils import get_file_content, get_mount_size
+
+
+_DYNAMIC = ('/etc/mtab', '/proc/mounts', '/etc/mnttab')
+_STATIC = ('/etc/fstab', '/etc/vfstab', '/etc/filesystems')
+_ALIASES = {'all': _DYNAMIC + _STATIC, 'dynamic': _DYNAMIC, 'static': _STATIC}
+_BY_UUID = '/dev/disk/by-uuid'
+_DEFAULT_MOUNT_BINARY = 'mount'
+
+_OCTAL_ESCAPE = re.compile(r'\\([0-7]{3})')
+_LINUX_MOUNT = re.compile(r'(?P<device>.+?) on (?P<mount>.+?) type (?P<fstype>\S+) \((?P<options>.*)\)')
+_BSD_MOUNT = re.compile(r'(?P<device>.+?) on (?P<mount>.+?) \((?P<fstype>[^,]+?)(?:,(?P<options>.*))?\)')
+_AIX_MOUNT = re.compile(
+    r'[ \t]*(?:(?P<node>\S+)[ \t]+)?(?P<device>\S+)[ \t]+(?P<mount>\S+)[ \t]+(?P<fstype>\S+)[ \t]+'
+    r'(?P<time>[A-Za-z]{3}[ \t]+\d{1,2}[ \t]+\d{2}:\d{2})(?:[ \t]+(?P<options>\S.*))?'
+)
+
+
+@dataclass
+class MountInfo:
+    """A mount point, its original source text, and its parsed fields."""
+
+    mount_point: str
+    line: str
+    fields: dict
+
+
+@dataclass
+class MountInfoOptions(MountInfo):
+    """A parsed AIX stanza whose fields include an attributes dictionary."""
+
+
+def get_argument_spec():
+    """Return the Ansible module argument specification."""
+    return {
+        'sources': {'type': 'list', 'elements': 'str', 'default': None},
+        'mount_binary': {'type': 'raw', 'default': _DEFAULT_MOUNT_BINARY},
+        'devices': {'type': 'list', 'elements': 'str', 'default': None},
+        'fstypes': {'type': 'list', 'elements': 'str', 'default': None},
+        'timeout': {'type': 'float', 'default': None},
+        'on_timeout': {'type': 'str', 'choices': ['error', 'warn', 'ignore'], 'default': 'error'},
+        'include_aggregate_mounts': {'type': 'bool', 'default': None},
+    }
+
+
+def get_sources(module):
+    """Expand source aliases in order, retaining literal paths and duplicates."""
+    sources = module.params.get('sources')
+    if sources is None:
+        sources = ['all']
+    if '' in sources:
+        module.fail_json(msg='sources contains an empty string')
+    return [path for source in sources for path in _ALIASES.get(source, (source,))]
+
+
+def replace_octal_escapes(value):
+    """Decode three-digit octal escapes used in mount tables."""
+    return _OCTAL_ESCAPE.sub(lambda match: chr(int(match[1], 8)), value)
+
+
+def _column_entries(lines, columns):
+    for line in lines:
+        text = line.lstrip()
+        if not text or text.startswith('#'):
+            continue
+        fields = re.split(r'\s+#', text, maxsplit=1)[0].split()
+        if len(fields) < len(columns):
+            raise ValueError('Mount entry has too few columns')
+        yield line, fields, dict(zip(columns, map(replace_octal_escapes, fields)))
+
+
+def gen_fstab_entries(lines):
+    """Yield fstab mounts, raising ValueError for invalid columns."""
+    for line, values, fields in _column_entries(lines, ('device', 'mount', 'fstype', 'options')):
+        if len(values) >= 6:
+            fields['dump'], fields['passno'] = map(int, values[4:6])
+        yield MountInfo(fields['mount'], line, fields)
+
+
+def gen_vfstab_entries(lines):
+    """Yield Solaris vfstab mounts, raising ValueError for invalid columns."""
+    columns = ('device', 'device_to_fsck', 'mount', 'fstype', 'passno', 'mount_at_boot', 'options')
+    for line, unused_values, fields in _column_entries(lines, columns):
+        try:
+            fields['passno'] = int(fields['passno'])
+        except ValueError:
+            pass
+        yield MountInfo(fields['mount'], line, fields)
+
+
+def gen_mnttab_entries(lines):
+    """Yield Solaris mnttab mounts, requiring at least one ten-character timestamp."""
+    rows = list(_column_entries(lines, ('device', 'mount', 'fstype', 'options', 'time')))
+    if not any(len(values[4]) == 10 for unused_line, values, unused_fields in rows):
+        raise ValueError('No mnttab timestamps found')
+    for line, unused_values, fields in rows:
+        fields['time'] = int(fields['time'])
+        yield MountInfo(fields['mount'], line, fields)
+
+
+def list_aix_filesystems_stanzas(lines):
+    """Group AIX filesystem stanzas, discarding comments and blank lines."""
+    stanzas = []
+    for line in lines:
+        text = line.strip()
+        if not text or text.startswith('*'):
+            continue
+        if text.endswith(':') and '=' not in text:
+            stanzas.append([line])
+        elif stanzas and '=' in text:
+            stanzas[-1].append(line)
+        else:
+            return []
+    return stanzas
+
+
+def gen_aix_filesystems_entries(lines):
+    """Yield AIX filesystem mounts and all of their stanza attributes."""
+    for header, *body in list_aix_filesystems_stanzas(lines):
+        mount = header.strip()[:-1]
+        attributes = {}
+        for line in body:
+            attr, value = line.split('=', 1)
+            attributes[attr.strip()] = value.strip()
+        device = attributes.get('dev')
+        node = attributes.get('nodename')
+        if device and node:
+            device = f'{node}:{device}'
+        fields = {
+            'mount': mount,
+            'device': device or 'unknown',
+            'fstype': attributes.get('vfs') or 'unknown',
+            'attributes': attributes,
+        }
+        yield MountInfoOptions(mount, '\n'.join([header, *body]), fields)
+
+
+def gen_mounts_by_file(file):
+    """Yield mounts from the first parser that accepts the entire file."""
+    content = get_file_content(file, strip=False)
+    if not content:
+        return
+    lines = content.splitlines()
+    for parser in (gen_vfstab_entries, gen_mnttab_entries, gen_fstab_entries, gen_aix_filesystems_entries):
+        try:
+            entries = list(parser(lines))
+        except ValueError:
+            continue
+        yield from entries
+        return
+
+
+def get_mount_pattern(stdout):
+    """Identify Linux, BSD, or AIX mount output, or return None."""
+    lines = stdout.splitlines()
+    for line in lines:
+        if _LINUX_MOUNT.fullmatch(line):
+            return _LINUX_MOUNT
+        if _BSD_MOUNT.fullmatch(line):
+            return _BSD_MOUNT
+    if any(_AIX_MOUNT.fullmatch(line) for line in lines[2:]):
+        return _AIX_MOUNT
+    return None
+
+
+def gen_mounts_from_stdout(stdout):
+    """Yield mounts from automatically detected mount command output."""
+    pattern = get_mount_pattern(stdout)
+    if pattern is None:
+        return
+    lines = stdout.splitlines()
+    if pattern is _AIX_MOUNT:
+        lines = lines[2:]
+    for line in lines:
+        match = pattern.fullmatch(line)
+        if not match:
+            continue
+        fields = match.groupdict()
+        if pattern is _AIX_MOUNT:
+            node = fields.pop('node')
+            if node:
+                fields['device'] = f"{node}:{fields['device']}"
+            fields['options'] = fields['options'] or ''
+        elif pattern is _BSD_MOUNT:
+            fields['fstype'] = fields['fstype'].strip()
+            if fields['options'] is None:
+                del fields['options']
+            else:
+                fields['options'] = fields['options'].strip()
+        yield MountInfo(fields['mount'], line, fields)
+
+
+def handle_timeout(module, default=None):
+    """Apply the configured policy to a timeout, returning default if continuing."""
+    def decorator(func):
+        @wraps(func)
+        def wrapped(*args, **kwargs):
+            try:
+                return func(*args, **kwargs)
+            except (TimeoutError, TimeoutExpired) as exc:
+                policy = module.params.get('on_timeout') or 'error'
+                if policy == 'error':
+                    module.fail_json(msg=str(exc))
+                if policy == 'warn':
+                    module.warn(str(exc))
+                return default
+        return wrapped
+    return decorator
+
+
+def _timed_operation(module, func, default=None):
+    # The shared fact decorator imposes its own default deadline when given None.
+    seconds = module.params.get('timeout')
+    if seconds is not None and seconds > 0:
+        func = fact_timeout(seconds)(func)
+    return handle_timeout(module, default)(func)
+
+
+def run_mount_bin(module, mount_bin):
+    """Run the required mount executable and return its text output."""
+    path = module.get_bin_path(mount_bin, required=True)
+    try:
+        return subprocess.check_output(path, timeout=module.params.get('timeout'), text=True)
+    except CalledProcessError as exc:
+        module.fail_json(msg=f"Failed to execute {path}: {str(exc).rstrip('.')}")
+    except OSError as exc:
+        module.fail_json(msg=f'Failed to execute {path}: {exc}')
+
+
+def gen_mounts_by_source(module):
+    """Yield (source, mount point, line, fields), with the command fallback last."""
+    sources = get_sources(module)
+    if len(set(sources)) != len(sources):
+        module.warn("mount_facts option 'sources' contains duplicate entries, repeat sources will be ignored: %r" % sources)
+
+    seen = set()
+    found_dynamic = False
+    read = _timed_operation(module, lambda path: list(gen_mounts_by_file(path)), [])
+    for source in sources:
+        if source == 'mount' or source in seen:
+            continue
+        target = _timed_operation(module, os.path.realpath)(source)
+        if target is None or target in seen:
+            continue
+        seen.update((source, target))
+        for entry in read(source):
+            if source in _DYNAMIC:
+                found_dynamic = True
+            yield source, entry.mount_point, entry.line, entry.fields
+
+    mount_bin = module.params.get('mount_binary', _DEFAULT_MOUNT_BINARY)
+    if 'mount' in sources or (mount_bin is not None and not found_dynamic and any(path in _DYNAMIC for path in sources)):
+        stdout = handle_timeout(module, '')(run_mount_bin)(module, _DEFAULT_MOUNT_BINARY if mount_bin is None else mount_bin)
+        for entry in gen_mounts_from_stdout(stdout):
+            yield 'mount', entry.mount_point, entry.line, entry.fields
+
+
+@lru_cache
+def list_uuids_linux():
+    """List the available UUID symlinks, or an empty list when unavailable."""
+    try:
+        return os.listdir(_BY_UUID)
+    except OSError:
+        return []
+
+
+def _uuid_from_links(device):
+    for uuid in list_uuids_linux():
+        if os.path.realpath(f'{_BY_UUID}/{uuid}') == device:
+            return uuid
+    return None
+
+
+def _run_uuid_command(module, command):
+    path = module.get_bin_path(command[0])
+    if path:
+        try:
+            return subprocess.check_output([path, *command[1:]], timeout=module.params.get('timeout'), text=True)
+        except (CalledProcessError, OSError):
+            pass
+    return ''
+
+
+@lru_cache
+def run_lsblk(module):
+    """Return device/UUID pairs from lsblk, omitting devices without a UUID."""
+    stdout = _run_uuid_command(module, ['lsblk', '--list', '--noheadings', '--paths', '--output', 'NAME,UUID', '--exclude', '2'])
+    return [pair for line in stdout.splitlines() if len(pair := line.split()) == 2]
+
+
+@lru_cache
+def get_device_by_uuid(module, uuid):
+    """Return the device found by findfs, or None if it cannot be looked up."""
+    return _run_uuid_command(module, ['findfs', f'UUID={uuid}']).strip() or None
+
+
+@lru_cache
+def get_udevadm_device_uuid(module, device):
+    """Return the ID_FS_UUID property reported by udevadm, if present."""
+    stdout = _run_uuid_command(module, ['udevadm', 'info', '--query', 'property', '--name', device])
+    for line in stdout.splitlines():
+        if line.startswith('ID_FS_UUID='):
+            return line.partition('=')[2] or None
+    return None
+
+
+def get_partition_uuid(module, partname):
+    """Return the first UUID found in the symlink directory, lsblk, or udevadm."""
+    uuid = _timed_operation(module, _uuid_from_links)(partname)
+    if uuid:
+        return uuid
+    for device, uuid in handle_timeout(module, [])(run_lsblk)(module):
+        if device == partname:
+            return uuid
+    return handle_timeout(module)(get_udevadm_device_uuid)(module, partname)
+
+
+def get_mount_facts(module):
+    """Collect filtered mount facts, with source context, UUID, and available usage."""
+    devices = module.params.get('devices')
+    fstypes = module.params.get('fstypes')
+    mounts = []
+    for source, mount_point, line, fields in gen_mounts_by_source(module):
+        device = fields['device']
+        if devices is not None and not any(fnmatchcase(device, pattern) for pattern in devices):
+            continue
+        if fstypes is not None and not any(fnmatchcase(fields['fstype'], pattern) for pattern in fstypes):
+            continue
+        mount = dict(fields, ansible_context={'source': source, 'source_data': line}, uuid=get_partition_uuid(module, device))
+        size = _timed_operation(module, get_mount_size)(mount_point)
+        if size:
+            mount.update(size)
+        mounts.append(mount)
+    return mounts
+
+
+def handle_deduplication(module, mounts):
+    """Keep first mounts by point and optionally return all mounts in source order."""
+    mount_points = {}
+    seen = set()
+    repeats = set()
+    aggregate = module.params.get('include_aggregate_mounts')
+    for mount in mounts:
+        point = mount['mount']
+        mount_points.setdefault(point, mount)
+        if aggregate is None:
+            source = mount['ansible_context']['source']
+            key = (point, source)
+            if key in seen:
+                repeats.add(source)
+            seen.add(key)
+    if repeats:
+        module.warn("Ignoring repeat mounts from sources %r; set include_aggregate_mounts to true to include them." % sorted(repeats))
+    return mount_points, mounts if aggregate else []
+
+
+def main():
+    """Validate inputs and return mount_points and aggregate_mounts as facts."""
+    module = AnsibleModule(argument_spec=get_argument_spec(), supports_check_mode=True)
+    seconds = module.params['timeout']
+    if seconds is not None and not seconds > 0:
+        module.fail_json(msg="argument 'timeout' must be a positive number or null")
+    mount_bin = module.params['mount_binary']
+    if mount_bin is not None and not isinstance(mount_bin, str):
+        module.fail_json(msg=f"argument 'mount_binary' must be a string or null, not {mount_bin}")
+
+    points, aggregate = handle_deduplication(module, get_mount_facts(module))
+    module.exit_json(ansible_facts={'mount_points': points, 'aggregate_mounts': aggregate})
+
+
+if __name__ == '__main__':
+    main()

+package public

+	return get(ctx, id, size)
+}
+
+func TestPublicArtworkSize(t *testing.T) {
+	auth.Init(&tests.MockDataStore{})
+
+	for _, tc := range []struct {
+		name   string
+		claims map[string]any
+		query  string
+		status int
+		size   int
+	}{
+		{"original by default", map[string]any{"id": "ar-1234"}, "", http.StatusOK, 0},
+		{"size from the query", map[string]any{"id": "ar-1234"}, "?size=15", http.StatusOK, 15},
+		{"ignore the legacy claim", map[string]any{"id": "ar-1234", "size": 100}, "?size=15", http.StatusOK, 15},
+		{"reject oversized requests", map[string]any{"id": "ar-1234"}, "?size=4097", http.StatusBadRequest, 0},
+		{"reject invalid sizes", map[string]any{"id": "ar-1234"}, "?size=large", http.StatusBadRequest, 0},
+	} {
+		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
+			token, err := auth.CreatePublicToken(tc.claims)
+			if err != nil {
+				t.Fatal(err)
+			}
+			router := New(artworkGetter(func(_ context.Context, id string, size int) (io.ReadCloser, time.Time, error) {
+				if tc.status != http.StatusOK || id != "ar-1234" || size != tc.size {
+					t.Fatalf("unexpected artwork request: id=%q size=%d", id, size)
+				}
+				return io.NopCloser(strings.NewReader("artwork")), time.Time{}, nil
+			}))
+			w := httptest.NewRecorder()
+			router.ServeHTTP(w, httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "/img/"+token+tc.query, nil))
+			if w.Code != tc.status {
+				t.Fatalf("got status %d, want %d", w.Code, tc.status)
+			}
+			if tc.status == http.StatusOK && w.Body.String() != "artwork" {
+				t.Fatalf("got body %q, want artwork", w.Body.String())
+			}
+		})
+	}
